reason: Not an existing F1/FE partner (Lyten's motorsport activity is Lyten Motorsports, an Indianapolis parts venture with INDYCAR Experience and a sponsored two-seat IndyCar, launched 23 May 2025) and not contradicted, but the row's trigger is mis-dated and inflated, and the honest score lands under the MD threshold of 70. The completed acquisition of Northvolt Sweden (Lyten release, 26 Feb 2026) is 190 days before the row's date and therefore stale; the EXIM letters of interest for up to $650M date from 18 Dec 2024, not 2026; and the '$1.33B raised to date' counts those undrawn LOIs as money raised — Lyten's own boilerplate puts equity at more than $625M, the last round being $200M+ from existing investors on 28 Jul 2025 (Yahoo Finance / Mercom; Series B valuation ~$1.5B in Sep 2023, reported). The only event inside the 90-day window is the exclusive MOU of 1 Jul 2026 with KfW, Northvolt Drei Project GmbH and LG Batterie GmbH to progress the purchase of the Northvolt Drei site near Heide (reported price ~€60M, electrive 22 Jun 2026), with a definitive agreement targeted for Q3 2026. An MOU on a distressed-asset purchase is an identity story, not a capital-and-identity inflection: no new equity, the EXIM package undrawn, and the balance sheet committed to restarting Skellefteå, a Polish hub (Mar 2026), Heide and the Reno gigafactory. Honest score ~66/100 (timing 13, capacity 11, brand fit 16, urgency 12, ops fit 14): brand fit is genuinely strong (a lithium-sulfur and 3D Graphene company in an electric series, with an existing motorsport parts business that could supply composite parts for team-developed GEN4 components) and Andretti Formula E would be the team (American, Nissan GEN4 powertrain from 24 Jul 2026, Austin and Miami rounds in Season 13, no battery or materials partner on its roster), but capacity and the weight of the trigger hold it back. Leadership: Dan Cook, Co-Founder, President & CEO (ex-GM, NeXT, Nortel, Cerberus operating executive); no CMO, CCO or CFO found on any listing; no motorsport tie found beyond the company's own INDYCAR Experience sponsorship. Re-open on the definitive Heide agreement or a 2026 equity round, when the same Andretti case clears 70 on capacity.
